description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples generated from high-throughput sequencing in agricultural fields across regions, designed to capture location, crop, management, soil properties, and sequencing context for microbiome and yield-related analyses.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

field_id.descr: Unique identifier for the agricultural field from which the sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the field is located.

region.descr: Administrative or biogeographical region/state/province within the country.

site_name.descr: Local site or farm name associated with the sampling location.

latitude.descr: GPS latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: GPS longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location above sea level, in meters.

sampling_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the field at the time of sampling, preferably using a controlled vocabulary (e.g., maize, wheat, soybean).

crop_variety.descr: Cultivar or variety of the crop, if known.

cropping_system.descr: Cropping system or rotation context (e.g., monoculture, rotation, intercropping).

farming_system.descr: Overall management system, such as organic, conventional, regenerative, or integrated.

management_practice.descr: Specific agricultural practice(s) applied to the field, such as tillage, no-till, fertilizer regime, irrigation, or pesticide use; use controlled terms where possible.

organic_certified.descr: Whether the field is formally certified organic.

fertilizer_type.descr: Primary fertilizer type applied, if any (e.g., synthetic, manure, compost, none).

irrigation_practice.descr: Irrigation status or method used in the field (e.g., rainfed, drip, sprinkler).

tillage_practice.descr: Tillage regime used (e.g., conventional tillage, reduced tillage, no-till).

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or texture class at the sampling site, such as sandy loam, loam, clay loam, or a taxonomic class if available.

soil_texture.descr: Observed or classified soil texture category following standard soil texture classes.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured using the study's reported method; report as unitless pH value.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent by weight or volumetric percent; specify method in accompanying documentation.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content expressed as percent, if measured.

soil_carbon_percent.descr: Total soil carbon content expressed as percent, if measured.

soil_nitrogen_percent.descr: Total soil nitrogen content expressed as percent, if measured.

soil_bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in grams per cubic centimeter, if measured.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Sampling depth interval in centimeters below the soil surface, or the nominal depth if a single value is used.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient or soil temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius, if measured.

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation at or near the site for the relevant period, in millimeters, if recorded.

microbial_assay_type.descr: Sequencing assay used for microbial profiling, such as 16S rRNA amplicon, ITS amplicon, shotgun metagenomics, or metatranscriptomics.

target_marker.descr: Targeted genetic marker or region sequenced, if applicable (e.g., 16S V4, ITS1, ITS2).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio, or Oxford Nanopore.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation or amplification method used for sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the primary reads produced by the sequencing run.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or accession associated with the sample, if applicable.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier for technical or biological replicates, if applicable.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for the soil sample.

biomass_yield_ng.descr: Total extracted DNA yield in nanograms, if measured.

library_size_reads.descr: Number of reads generated for this sample after sequencing or after initial processing, depending on how the field is defined.

crop_yield_kg_ha.descr: Crop yield associated with the field, expressed in kilograms per hectare for the relevant season, if available.

yield_measurement_unit.descr: Unit used for yield reporting if different from kg/ha; prefer standardized units.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for any additional relevant sample context, anomalies, or missing-value explanations.
